UserLoginDB.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the instance by opening or creating a SQLite database connection for db_name and creating a cursor bound to that connection." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> db_name </REF>: str or os.PathLike "SQLite database path, filename, ':memory:' for an in-memory database, or empty string for a temporary on-disk database; passed directly to sqlite3.connect."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Open or create the SQLite database identified by db_name using sqlite3.connect(db_name) with default SQLite connection settings, and assign the returned connection object to self.connection. RESULT self.connection]
            [COMMAND Create a cursor from the newly assigned self.connection by calling self.connection.cursor(), and assign the returned cursor object to self.cursor. RESULT self.cursor]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: sqlite3.connect(db_name) fails because db_name is invalid, None, not path-like, or the database cannot be opened or created.]
        [LOG "Failed to initialize SQLite connection for db_name."]
        [THROW sqlite3.Error "The SQLite connection error raised by sqlite3.connect(db_name) and propagated to the caller."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
UserLoginDB.insert_user:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Inserts a new user record with the given username and password into the users table and commits the database transaction." insert_user]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> username </REF>: string "Username to insert into the users table."
        <REF> password </REF>: string "Password to insert into the users table."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Execute a parameterized INSERT statement on self.cursor using the SQL 'INSERT INTO users (username, password) VALUES (?, ?)' with bound parameters (username, password). RESULT insert_execution]
            [COMMAND Commit the pending database transaction by calling self.connection.commit() to persist the inserted user row. RESULT commit_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
UserLoginDB.search_user_by_username:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Executes a parameterized SQL query to search the users table by username and returns the first matching row, or None if no matching user exists." search_user_by_username]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> username </REF>: string "Username value to search for in the users table."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> user </REF>: object|null "First matching user row from the database, or None if no matching user exists."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Execute the parameterized SQL query 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?' on self.cursor using username as the bound parameter. RESULT cursor_result]
            [COMMAND Fetch the next row from the cursor and assign it to user; if no matching user exists, this returns None. RESULT user]
            [COMMAND Return user. RESULT user]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
UserLoginDB.delete_user_by_username:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Delete the user record whose username matches the given parameter and commit the database transaction." delete_user_by_username]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> username </REF>: string "The username value used to identify the row to delete from the users table."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Execute a parameterized DELETE statement on self.cursor against the users table, deleting rows where username equals the provided username parameter. This succeeds even if no matching row exists and zero rows are affected. RESULT delete_result]
            [COMMAND Commit the current transaction on self.connection to persist the deletion. RESULT commit_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
UserLoginDB.validate_user_login:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Validates a username and password by searching for the user and checking whether the stored password matches the supplied password." validate_user_login]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> username </REF>: string "Username used to search for the user record."
        <REF> password </REF>: string "Password to compare against the stored password of the found user."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if the user exists and the stored password matches the supplied password; otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.search_user_by_username(username) and assign the returned value to user. RESULT user]
            [COMMAND If user is not None and user[1] equals password, return True. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: user is None or user[1] does not equal password]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
